messages:
Ava: Low-key idea 1: throwback night Friday? Classics vs Modern split-screen.
Ava: Two zones: Retro (SNES/N64/Arcade) and Modern (Switch/Steam Deck/PS). Swap at halftime.
Diego: Love this. I can bring my CRT and a box of controllers. Warning: its heavy. :sweat_smile:
Priya: Ill bring my docked Switch and a Mario Party cart. Also got a tiny arcade cabinet kit to demo.
Marco: Count me in. Ill bring Tekken 3 + an extra PS2 pad and some ridiculous arcade sticks.
Ava: Poll: should we do a meme costume prompt? React :tophat: for goofy hats / :retro: for pixel tees / :no_entry_sign: no costumes.
Diego: :tophat:
Priya: :retro:
Marco: :retro:
sticker-bot: Ava added :joystick: sticker to the thread.
Ava: Quick logistics: need extension cords, a power strip with surge, and a small dolly for the CRT.
Diego: I have a heavy-duty strip and a dolly.
Priya: I can bring a Cat6 cable in case someone wants low-lat lobby play.
Marco: Also, anyone allergic to peanuts? Im bringing spicy peanut brittle (naughty and nice).
Ava: Note: Caroline allergic. No peanuts near the couch.
Priya: Good call. I'll swap to pretzel mix instead.
Ava: If folks want to sign up for the 4-player tournament slots, drop an emoji under your preferred zone. Half-time shuffle at 9:30.
Diego: I'll take Retro tournament slot 1.
Marco: Modern slot 2.
Ava: Cool, sticky note on kitchen board and reminder in calendar.
